comment: Radisson Hotel Group global brand — separate from Choice-affiliated Radisson Blu (Choice). Explorer presentation for RHG should be built separately; this patches Brand Basics only.
suggestedTargetGuestSegments: Design-conscious business and leisure travelers; urban professionals and explorers seeking memorable, stylish stays; global upper-upscale guest who values Nordic-inspired design and curatorial service outside Choice-only narratives.

fields.Brand Positioning: Radisson Blu exists to redefine the upper-upscale hospitality experience globally—style with substance, innovation with comfort, and belonging in an elevated environment. Nordic Nouveau design, Enticing Moments, and Curatorial Warmth define the guest journey across urban, airport, resort, and serviced-apartment formats.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Memorable, stylish, purposeful stays—Scandinavian-inspired comfort and warmth in dynamic, stimulating spaces.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: transcend the ordinary through design-led upper-upscale experiences.

Owners: one of the largest upper-upscale brands in Europe and a global footprint (verify live counts with RHG)—iconic design heritage from the Arne Jacobsen lineage.

Operators: upper-upscale standards with global brand recognition; program and distribution via Radisson Hotel Group systems (not Choice Privileges unless a specific market agreement says otherwise).
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Enticing Moments — belonging, discovery, memorable innovation.

Nordic Nouveau — Scandinavian-inspired iconic environments.

Curatorial Warmth — gallery-curator service mindset.

Global scale — 300+ hotels worldwide (verify with RHG; EMEA/APAC heavy vs. selective Americas).
fields.Brand Pillars: Enticing Moments · Nordic Nouveau · Curatorial Warmth
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: The Inspired Professional and design-aware traveler—allergic to boring big-box hotels; seeks art, culture, and discovery; expects seamless technology and flexible in-room and public-space functionality.
fields.Brand History: Born from Danish designer Arne Jacobsen's 1960 design-hotel vision; today Radisson Blu is RHG's upper-upscale flagship design brand across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific with selective Americas presence. (Verify geography and counts with RHG/Legal.)
